kdpTools.title: Free KDP tools
kdpTools.intro: Four calculators for Amazon KDP paperbacks, every number checked against KDP's published specifications. No login, no email gate.

items.name: KDP cover calculator
items.description: Spine width and full wraparound cover size from page count, paper and trim, in inches and millimetres.

items.name: KDP royalty calculator
items.description: Printing cost, the 50% or 60% tier, royalty per sale and the minimum list price for every Amazon marketplace.

items.name: KDP trim sizes
items.description: Every paperback trim size with page limits by paper type, margin rules and bleed, as plain HTML tables.

items.name: KDP page count estimator
items.description: Words to pages for a given trim, font, point size and line spacing, then straight into the cover calculator.
